title: Billed Visits Counted as Used Before Posting, Referrals and Authorizations Cancellations
content:
When an approved authorization under **Referrals and Authorizations** counted in visits, hours or rental months is cancelled, visits the servicing provider has billed count as used even before their use entries are posted, over the window the authorization's issue makes relevant.

## Evidence on file

- The authorization's unit history: whether it shows a grant on an appeal overturn, and the units already posted as used.
- The servicing provider's claim lines among the patient's TRICARE Select claim lines: those dated in the last month, and all of them.

## Clause

1. Where the unit history shows a grant on an appeal overturn (care was given while the denial stood), the servicing provider's claim lines dated in the last month count as used, less the uses already posted (never fewer than zero lines).
2. Where it shows no such grant and the servicing provider's claim lines outnumber the uses posted, every one of those lines beyond the posted uses counts as used.
3. Otherwise only the posted uses count.

The lines counted as used are taken off the units left, in addition to the posted uses.

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

| Grant on an appeal overturn | Servicing provider's lines in the last month | All of its lines | Uses posted | Lines counted as used |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| yes | 6 | 9 | 2 | 4 |
| yes | 1 | 9 | 2 | 0 |
| no | 3 | 9 | 7 | 2 |
| no | 3 | 7 | 7 | 0 |
